title: EEL conformance case group
description: A group of executable conformance cases pinning MilkDrop EEL platform semantics. Any implementation can run these; see README.md for the runner contract.

slotMap.description: Buffer slots as index -> value. Indices are decimal integer strings.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the group. Never reuse an id for different semantics.

name.description: One sentence stating the rule the case pins.

program.description: EEL statements, executed in order as one block.

env.description: Initial variable values. Absent variables start at 0.

expected.description: Required variable values after the block runs.

note.description: Why the value is what it is, and what depends on it.

status.description: pinned: derived from documented MilkDrop 2.x / ns-eel behavior. provisional: this implementation's observed behavior, NOT yet confirmed against the reference. A provisional case is a question, not a requirement.
